    Spa Days in Windermere, Lake District

    You’ll find a world of peace and tranquillity at the Old England Hotel & Spa. Situated on the waterfront of magical Lake Windermere and when joining us for a spa day in the Lake District you’ll find a beautiful environment and range of indulgent treatments for you to enjoy.

    Choose from one of our full or half day spa days – the perfect excuse to indulge in some quality ‘me’ time – with the stunning landscape of the Lake District and views over Windermere the perfect setting for relaxation.

    from £109

    My Morning Retreat

    What better way to start your day than a morning at the spa? From the moment you arrive, indulge in relaxation with a relaxing 25-minute ELEMIS treatment, before unwinding in serene surroundings and enjoying full use of our spa with use of fluffy robes, towels and slippers

    Finish your morning with a delicious two-course lunch in our Lakeside Restaurant, with stunning views of the Cumbrian countryside.

    Book Midweek Book Weekend

    What's Included

    • Robes, towels and slippers

    • One 25-minute ELEMIS treatment

    • Use of spa and leisure facilities between 9am and 12pm

    • Spa lunch

    from £109

    Summer Serenity Ritual Spa Day

    Schedule time for yourself amidst the chaos of summer and focus on your mind and body. Whether you’re looking to unwind, restore energy, or boost radiance, every detail is tailored just for you.

     Included in your Experience

    • ELEMIS 55-minute face & body treatment
    • FREE ELEMIS gift set & travel bag worth £98*
    • Complimentary £10 voucher off, any future facial booked
    • Full use of our spa & leisure facilities
    • Complimentary use of robes & towels
    • Skin consultation and personalised skincare advice
    • Free £5 voucher to redeem on skincare purchases on the day
    Book Midweek Book Weekend

    What's Included

    • ELEMIS 55-minute face & body treatment

    • Receive a FREE ELEMIS gift set & travel bag worth £98*

    • Full use of spa and leisure facilities

    • Complimentary robe, towels & slippers

    from £109

    My Afternoon Escape

    Escape the everyday and spend the afternoon relaxing in our indulgent spa between 12pm and 3pm. 

    Wind down with a soothing 25-minute ELEMIS treatment (Deep Tissue Massage, Superfood Facial or Best Foot Forward), and then benefit from full use of our spa before indulging in a delicious afternoon tea. If you’re feeling decadent, why not treat yourself and upgrade to a luxurious Champagne afternoon tea!

    Book Midweek Book Weekend

    What's Included

    • Robes, towels and slippers

    • One 25-minute ELEMIS treatment

    • Use of spa and leisure facilities between 12pm and 3pm

    • Afternoon Tea

    from £70

    My Time for Me Spa Day

    Make time for yourself with our new Spa Day experience
    Unwind with a soothing 25-minute spa treatment, enjoy full use of our luxury spa facilities for 4 hours, and step into indulgence with robes, towels, and slippers included. This is your chance to slow down, recharge, and embrace relaxation - because you deserve a day that’s just for you.

    Book Midweek Book Weekend

    What's Included

    • One 25-minute ELEMIS or ishga treatment

    • Pool & leisure access

    • Towels, robes & slippers

    from £125

    My Perfect Treat Spa Day

    It's important to treat yourself from time to time! Unwind with a 55-minute ELEMIS treatment (Superfood Facial, Couture Touch or Prescribed Biotec Facial), before spending the rest of your day revelling in the rejuvenating qualities of our relaxation room, thermal suite, and pool.

    After your treatment, finish your spa day in Windermere by admiring the spectacular lakeside views from our veranda or taking a leisurely stroll along the shore, before a decadent afternoon tea specially prepared by our team of expert chefs.

    Book Midweek Book Weekend

    What's Included

    • 55-minute ELEMIS treatment

    • Towels, robes & slippers

    • Full access to our leisure club

    • Afternoon Tea

    from £109

    Spa Day for Two

    Stop and take a breath.
    Spend some me time with friends or family with our mini spa day for two.

    This midweek Spa Day includes full use of all our spa facilities, including complimentary fluffy robe and slippers, plus a 25-minute spa treatment per person.
    (Back, Neck and Shoulder Massage (ishga or Elemis), Pro-Glow Facial, ishga Facial, Intensely Cleansing Salt Scrub or File and Polish for Fingers or Toes.

    Only available Tuesday to Thursday and for direct bookings.
    This offer is only available for parties of 2 therefore any bookings for 1 may result in your reservation being cancelled.

    Book Midweek

    What's Included

    • Robes, towels and slippers

    • 25-minute spa treatment

    • Use of spa and leisure facilities

    • Free £5 voucher to use towards any spa product or gifts on the day

    from £175

    My Signature Spa Day

    Start your day of total relaxation with a stroll across the lawn to the water’s edge for an inspirational view of Lake Windermere. The calming surroundings of the Cumbrian countryside will make the MY Signature Spa Day feel extra special.

    Enjoy two ELEMIS treatments (a 55-minute Deep Tissue Massage and a 25-minute Superfood Facial) followed by unlimited use of the spa and leisure facilities with fluffy robes, towels and slippers. Unwind after your treatments with our specially prepared Afternoon Tea. Refreshed and rejuvenated, you’ll be in the ideal frame of mind to enjoy a delicious afternoon tea.

    Book Midweek Book Weekend

    What's Included

    • 85-minute total treatment time

    • Spa & leisure club access

    • Robe, slippers & towels

    • Afternoon Tea

    from £225

    My Total Time Out Spa Day

    Our spa on Lake Windermere provides the ultimate indulgent retreat and its setting - within the glorious landscape of the Lake District - will make your experience truly special.

    Begin your luxury spa day with two 55-minute ELEMIS treatments (a 55-minute Deep Tissue Massage, followed by either a 55-minute Superfood Facial or Biotec Facial). Post-treatments, activate full relaxation mode by enjoying a dip in our lakeside pool or detoxing in our thermal suite.

    Unwind after your treatment by tucking into a delicious two-course lunch or decadent afternoon tea overlooking the lake.

    Book Midweek Book Weekend

    Embrace the season with our My Summer Awakening spa experience. Join us between 9am and 12pm and enjoy a relaxing morning designed to leave you feeling refreshed, rebalanced and ready for the months ahead.

    This experience includes full use of our spa and leisure facilities, one 25-minute ELEMIS or ishga treatment, followed by a two-course spa lunch.
